title: Comparison table
idea: Comparison table: Aligned measures share units dates and a selected row inspector
audience: People who need to compare performance within a dashboard surface.
worksWellWhen: Users compare many records across common measures
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic ledger layout through its compare performance priority and explicit commitment contract: Sorting never changes underlying record values
navigation: Comparison table keeps the current compare performance context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Aligned measures share units dates and a selected row inspector
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to compare performance; users compare many records across common measures
composition.priority: Sorting never changes underlying record values

imagery.role: Support the actual compare performance context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Offer deliberate horizontal scrolling and a focused row view
Keep units, filters and selection understandable at narrow widths; expose a focused item view.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the comparison table structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no compare performance content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Sorting never changes underlying record values
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized compare performance content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Sorting never changes underlying record values
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active compare performance context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure bounded queries and large-data interaction; virtualize only with accessible alternatives.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
